title: Moving average over a sliding window
description:
src/stats.py has a function moving_average(values, k) that should return the mean of every window of k consecutive values, left to right.

For a list of n values and a window of size k there are n - k + 1 windows, so that is how many averages the function must return. Each average is a float.

The function must raise ValueError if k is zero or negative, and also if k is larger than the number of values, because no complete window exists in that case. It must not modify the list it is given.

Some of the tests in tests/test_visible.py are failing. Find out why and fix src/stats.py.
